reader_contract.pred_png_naming: {scene}_pred{frame}.png; GT is the same name with 'pred'->'gt'
reader_contract.packing: packed = semantic_1based*1000 + instance; PNG R/G/B = byte0/1/2
reader_contract.pred_json: list of {id, label_id, score}; the reader looks up info['id']==instance_id and averages info['score'] -> the official mAP DOES consume our score
reader_contract.map_labels: 0-based (semantic-1); GT stuff classes are dropped from mAP GT, predictions are not filtered
reader_contract.miou: MeanIoU(num_classes=len(id2label)+1, include_background=False, index format) over the concatenated pair frames
reader_contract.target_vs_context: context_seg_* covers the 2 context frames; target_seg_* covers all six frames the model saw (2 context + 4 novel), i.e. the official 'target' metrics INCLUDE the context frames
reader_contract.stuff_serialization: stuff keeps its 1-based semantic id with instance id 0
reader_contract.depth: depth/ PNG = metres*1000; the reader fits a per-image scale+shift from GT before absrel/rmse

notes: the official evaluator is the pinned SIU3R implementation; only the EvaluatorCfg we construct is ours (semantic-only and image/depth switches)
